MTCS.description: Material Coordinate System (MTCS). Defines a local coordinate system from an origin, a point on the X axis (P1), and a point on the XY plane (P2); all ten geometry fields are required.

NAME.description: Name of the material coordinate system.

ORIGINX.description: Origin X coordinate of the coordinate system (global).

ORIGINY.description: Origin Y coordinate of the coordinate system (global).

ORIGINZ.description: Origin Z coordinate of the coordinate system (global).

P1X.description: X coordinate of point P1, a point on the local X axis.

P1Y.description: Y coordinate of point P1, a point on the local X axis.

P1Z.description: Z coordinate of point P1, a point on the local X axis.

P2X.description: X coordinate of point P2, a point on the local XY plane.

P2Y.description: Y coordinate of point P2, a point on the local XY plane.

P2Z.description: Z coordinate of point P2, a point on the local XY plane.
